title: Property observers and oldValue
summary: Use didSet to count meaningful updates while ignoring assignments of the current value.
triggers: react to a stored property changing after initialization
prompts: Track the number of distinct score updates, excluding repeated assignments.
invariant: The change count increases only when the assigned score differs from the previous score.
mantra: Observe after assignment; compare with oldValue.
pitfalls: didSet runs even when the new value equals the old value.
Initial stored-property values do not trigger this observer.
